title: Why Bother with 3D? Core Benefits for Students & Small Brands
content:
![7c4a062972494ab2ac4ff64c8fe30b73](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/1433cd64cc2741dcb1fc585fe367ef13/images/7c4a062972494ab2ac4ff64c8fe30b73image_square_no_preview.jpg)

Thinking about integrating 3D into your fashion workflow but not sure where to start?

I just published a new Substack post all about that exact question:

In this post, I break down:  
✔️ Why 3D is worth your time (even on a small budget)  
✔️ Affordable software options (yes, free and student-friendly!)  
✔️ What kind of computer you really need  
✔️ How to start learning with minimal stress  
✔️ A phased plan to help you build skills without overwhelm

Whether you’re a student working on your portfolio or running a small brand trying to cut costs and get creative, this post is full of practical, realistic advice from someone who’s been through it.

🔗 Read it here: <https://giovanadebona.substack.com/p/why-bother-with-3d-8f8>

Let me know what you think or tag someone who’s just starting their 3D journey. Let's make fashion more accessible, sustainable, and fun to create.
content_description: This page helps fashion students and small brand owners confidently integrate affordable 3D tools into their workflow with practical, step-by-step guidance.
